description: Corrections to what AWS's Service Authorization Reference says these operations are authorized as, where a live call disagrees (scripts/iam.ts). Each `reason` is the evidence.

value.reason: Narrowed to AWS's ARN formats (arn:${Partition}:notifications::${Account}:managed-notification-configuration/category/*/sub-category/*/event/*/child-event/*), the call was denied live in the Notifications Bindings suite; the grant stays on *.
AWS lists it for the operation, but the Notifications Bindings suite calls it successfully without it.
Narrowed to AWS's ARN formats (arn:${Partition}:notifications:${Region}:${Account}:configuration/*/event/*), the call was denied live in the Notifications Bindings suite; the grant stays on *.
AWS lists it for the operation, but the Notifications Bindings suite calls it successfully without it.
